# 7476 - Dual J-K flip-flop with preset and clear

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7476.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7476.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 18 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7476 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7476.png) | ![7476 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7476.png) | ![7476 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7476.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 15 | 1Q = state1 | Stored bit of flip-flop 1. |
| 14 | /1Q = NOT state1 | Inverse of 1Q (both high while 1PR and 1CLR are both low). |
| 11 | 2Q = state2 | Stored bit of flip-flop 2. |
| 10 | /2Q = NOT state2 | Inverse of 2Q (both high while 2PR and 2CLR are both low). |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 2

Changes on: falling edge of nCK (master-slave), each flip-flop on its own clock

- PR low, CLR high: Q = 1, Q' = 0 at once
- PR high, CLR low: Q = 0, Q' = 1 at once
- PR low, CLR low: Q = 1 and Q' = 1; not stable, does not persist when PR and CLR return high
- Master-slave, pulse triggered: J and K are taken in while CK is high (setup 0 ns before the rising edge, hold 0 ns after the falling edge); the outputs change on the falling edge of CK
- On a CK pulse with clear/preset inactive: J=0 K=0 hold; J=1 K=0 Q=1; J=0 K=1 Q=0; J=1 K=1 toggle

## Notes

This is the plain '76 (master-slave, pulse triggered). The 74LS76 is negative-edge triggered. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
